ui.lead: Everything you need to use ICT Terminal: the ICT layers on the chart, the model scanner, drawing tools, alerts (also on WhatsApp), paper trading, the strategy tester, layouts with up to 8 charts and the phone app — step by step, with pictures.
ui.uinote: Buttons, tabs and menus are written in English inside the terminal. This guide shows them exactly as you see them, in **bold**.
ui.footer: ICT Terminal is a charting and analysis tool for education. It is not financial advice. Trading CFDs, forex, indices and crypto carries a high risk of losing money.

caps.overview: The terminal with four charts: top bar, drawing tools on the left, the right menu and the watchlist.

caps.templates: **Templates**: ready chart setups in one click. The ★ one is what new members start with.
caps.ict_layers: ICT layers on gold 15m: FVGs, order blocks, liquidity, structure, sessions, key levels, premium / discount and the daily bias.

caps.volume: Session Volume Profile: one profile for Asia, London and New York with the point of control.

caps.assistant: The **AI** assistant answers about the chart you are on, in English or Roman Urdu.

b: ICT Terminal is a charting terminal built for traders who use the **ICT (Inner Circle Trader)** concepts. It draws the concepts on the chart for you and scans the markets for rule-based ICT setups.

ul: **ICT layers:** fair value gaps (FVG / IFVG), order and breaker blocks, buy-side and sell-side liquidity, market structure (MSS / BOS), sessions and killzones, key opens, premium / discount and OTE, opening gaps, IPDA ranges, SMT and the daily bias.
**Model scanner:** 17 ICT models (Silver Bullet, 2022 model, Judas swing, OTE, Unicorn, Power of 3, news aftermath and more), each written as fixed rules with entry, stop and targets.
**A full terminal:** 1–8 charts per layout, 40+ drawing tools, indicators, alerts, paper trading, a strategy tester, a screener, the economic calendar and a community.

b.info: ICT Terminal does not trade for you unless you install the MT5 bridge yourself. Setups follow rules; many of them lose. Always test on a demo account first.

b: Open [ict.iccterminal.trade/terminal](https://ict.iccterminal.trade/terminal/) in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. Nothing has to be installed.

ol: Choose **Create account**, enter your e-mail and a password, or press **Continue as guest** to look around first.
The free plan opens straight away. To unlock every model in real time, open your account (the button at the top right) and choose **Upgrade or renew**.
Your screen — charts, drawings, indicators, watchlists and alerts — is saved to your account automatically and opens the same on every device.

ul: **Android:** download the app from the website (**Apps**). If Android asks, allow installing apps from your browser.
**Windows:** the terminal in its own window; it installs itself on the first run.
Both apps load the same terminal, so every new feature reaches them without a new download.

head: Area
What is there
rows: Symbol search, intervals, chart type, **Indicators**, **Templates**, **Compare**, **ICT**, **Wolf Models**, **Screener**, alerts, replay, undo / redo, layout, screenshot, full screen, settings and your account. When the bar is wider than the screen, use the mouse wheel or the ‹ › arrows.
Drawing tools in groups, the magnet, stay-in-drawing mode, lock / hide / remove all drawings.
**Watchlist**, **Signals**, **Trade**, **AI**, **Alerts**, **Calendar**, **News**, **Object tree**, **Data window**, the journal and, below a line, **Community** and **ICC**.
One to eight charts. Click a chart to make it active: the top bar always works on the active chart.

b.tip: Right-click a chart for the chart menu (go to date, chart type, price scale, new window, settings). Right-click the price scale on the right for the price-scale menu.

ul: **Symbol:** click the symbol at the top (or just start typing on the chart) and search. Click the symbol in a chart's title to change only that chart.
**Interval:** 1m to monthly, or type a number (for example `90` or `2h`) for a custom interval.
**Chart type:** candles, hollow candles, Heikin Ashi, bars, line, area, Renko, line break, range bars, baseline and columns.
**Layout:** the layout button at the top right offers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 or 8 charts (as many as your plan allows). Sync symbol, interval and crosshair between charts there too.
**Close a chart:** the ✕ in its corner. **One chart big:** layout menu → **Show only the active chart**.
**Templates:** a ready chart setup — layout, intervals, indicators, ICT layers and models — in one click. Your watchlist, alerts and drawings stay.
**Saved layouts:** layout menu → **Save as…**; open them again from the same menu on any device.
**New window:** right-click → **Open this chart in a new window** (for a second monitor).
**Go to date:** right-click → **Go to date…** or Alt+G. **Bar replay:** the replay button in the top bar.

b: Right-click the price scale: **Auto (fit)**, **Lock range** (the scale stays while you scroll), **Lock price / bar** (the same price per bar when you zoom), **Regular**, **Log**, **Percent**, **Invert** and the side of the scale.
Open the **ICT** menu in the top bar and switch on the layers you want. They are calculated by the engine for the symbol and interval of each chart.

head: Layer
What it shows
rows: Bullish (BISI) and bearish (SIBI) fair value gaps with the 50% line (CE). A gap that price closes through becomes an inversion FVG.
The last opposite candle before a displacement; failed ones become breaker blocks.
Buy-side (BSL) and sell-side (SSL) liquidity at swing highs / lows and equal highs / lows, marked when swept.
MSS (market structure shift, against the trend) and BOS (break of structure, with the trend).
Asia, London and New York, the killzones, the Silver Bullet windows and the 90-minute quarters, in New York time.
Midnight and 08:30 opens, previous day / week highs and lows.
The dealing range, its 50% (equilibrium) and the 62–79% optimal trade entry zone.
Standard deviations of the Asian range and CBDR, NWOG / NDOG opening gaps, the 20 / 40 / 60-day ranges.
Divergence against the partner market (gold–silver, Nasdaq–S&P), big displacement candles, and the daily bias panel with the draw on liquidity.

b.tip: Too much on the chart? Switch layers off per chart, or change the colours in **Settings**.

b: The engine scans the markets with every model and stores each setup with its entry, stop, targets, grade and checklist.

ol: In the **ICT** menu, tick the models you want to see on a chart. Their setups are drawn as boxes with entry, stop and targets.
Open **Signals** on the right: pick the models, the time span (30 minutes to 7 days), the grade (all, A, A+) and whether only setups **with the daily bias** count.
Click a signal to jump to it on the chart. Turn on **notify** for a sound and a desktop notification on new A / A+ setups.
The journal (bottom panel) shows how each past setup ended: TP1–TP3, stop, breakeven or not filled, with the R result.

head: Grade
Meaning
rows: Every point of the model's checklist is met, including the daily bias.
A valid setup with more points missing: for study rather than for trading.

b.warn: No model has a proven edge yet. M11 (IFVG reversal) is off by default because it tested weakest; you can still choose it. Results of the past do not promise future results.

ul: Lines, Fibonacci (with the ICT levels 0.62 / 0.705 / 0.79 and the extensions), channels, pitchfork, Gann fan, XABCD / ABCD, head and shoulders, Elliott waves, shapes, text and notes.
ICT tools: FVG box with CE, order block with mean threshold, liquidity line (BSL / SSL), OTE tool, dealing range and killzone box.
Measure: long / short position with risk-reward, price & date range, date range, anchored VWAP and **Fixed range volume profile**. Shift + click on the chart measures quickly.

b: Double-click a drawing (or press the gear on its small bar) for **Style**, **Text**, **Coordinates** and **Visibility**. In **Visibility** you can show a drawing only on chosen intervals — for example a 1H FVG only on 1m–15m charts.

b.tip: Select a line or a box and press ⏰ on its bar to create an alert from it.

sections.t: Indicators, volume profiles and ICT Script

ul: **Indicators** in the top bar: about 30 indicators (moving averages, VWAP, SuperTrend, Bollinger, RSI, MACD, ATR, volume and more). Search, add, and in **On this chart** change settings, colour, width, hide or remove.
Price indicators (moving averages, VWAP …) can move into their own pane with **↓ Own pane** and back with **↑ On price**; pane indicators (RSI, MACD, volume) move up and down with ▲ ▼.
**Volume profiles:** VPVR (visible range), SVP (one profile per session or per day) and the fixed range drawing, each with the point of control (POC) and the value area.
**Apply to all charts** copies the indicators of the active chart to every chart.

b: In **Indicators → My scripts → + New script** write a few lines, for example:

ul: Values: `open high low close volume hl2 hlc3 ohlc4`; `close[1]` is the previous bar.
Functions: `sma ema rma wma rsi atr highest lowest stdev change abs max min`; up to 6 `plot()` lines; `@pane` on the first line draws it in its own pane.
The check below the editor shows errors with the line number. **Save and add to chart** keeps it in your account.

b: Open **Alerts** on the right. Alerts work while the terminal is open on any of your devices; WhatsApp alerts are sent by the server.

head: Alert
How to create it
rows: Enter a price and choose **Crossing**, **Above** or **Below**. Alt+A sets one at the last price.
Select a trend line, a box, an FVG or an order block on the chart and press ⏰.
Pick a session (killzones, Silver Bullet windows, New York open) → **Daily session alert**. It fires every day.
Under **ICT event**: MSS, BOS, new FVG or liquidity sweep, an interval (1m–4H) and a direction. It fires on every new event.

ol: In **Alerts → WhatsApp alerts** enter your number in international format, digits only (for example `923001234567`).
Choose the lowest grade, and if you like only some models or symbols, and whether only setups with the bias count.
Turn on **Auto notify**, save, and press **Test**. Each new setup is sent once; plans with a delay send it after the delay.

b.tip: Turn on desktop notifications (the button in the Alerts tab) so you hear alerts even in another window.

b: Practise without real money. The paper account starts with 10,000 USD (you can reset it with any balance).

ol: Open **Trade** on the right, or use the **SELL** / **BUY** buttons on the active chart with the quantity between them.
Choose **Market**, **Limit** or **Stop**, the quantity, and an optional **Stop loss** and **Take profit**. Risk, reward and R are shown before you place it.
Positions and orders are drawn on the chart. Drag the SL, TP or order line to move it.
Close with ✕ in **Positions**; finished trades are in **History** with the P&L and the win rate.

b.info: Orders are filled by the server on 1-minute bars: limit and stop orders fill at their price, a gap fills at the open, and when one bar touches both the stop and the target, the stop counts first.

ol: Open the bottom panel (the journal button on the right menu, or settings → **Journal & stats panel**) and choose **Strategy tester**.
Pick a model, 30, 60 or 90 days and whether the daily bias is required, then **Run test**.
You see the setups, fills, win rate, average R, total R, profit factor, the largest drawdown, an equity curve and every trade (click one to see it on the chart).

b: **Screener** in the top bar shows every symbol in one table: daily bias, premium or discount, sweeps of the previous day's high / low, the nearest 15m and 1H FVGs, the killzone now and today's setups. Click a row to open that chart.

sections.t: Calendar, news and the AI assistant

ul: **Calendar:** the economic events of the week with impact and currency filters; click one to see its time on the chart. High-impact news also shows as a mark on the chart and a countdown tag.
**News:** the latest market headlines.
**AI:** ask about the active chart — bias, key levels, liquidity, open gaps, the latest setups and their time. It answers in English or Roman Urdu from the engine's own data.

b.warn: Models do not open new trades around high-impact news (15 minutes before and after), and on FOMC days positions are closed before 14:00 New York.

ul: **Community** (right menu): share a trade idea with a picture of your chart, like and comment on ideas, and chat in the rooms. The same ideas are on the website.
Choose a nickname and accept the rules the first time. Reports go to the moderators.
**ICC** (right menu): opens ICC Terminal next to your charts with its own login — docked, full screen or in a new tab.
On a phone the tools are on top, the charts in the middle and the menu (Watchlist, Signals, Trade, AI, Alerts …) at the bottom; slide the bottom menu sideways for Community and ICC.
With 2–8 charts, **▦ All** shows every chart on the screen, **▢ One** shows one at a time with chips to switch.
Tablets in portrait show up to 8 charts in two columns.
Pinch to zoom, drag to scroll, long-press for the crosshair; drawing works with the finger.
The account button at the top right shows your plan, its expiry and what it includes (charts per layout, ICT indicators, models, signal delay, alerts, backtests).
**Upgrade or renew:** choose a plan and pay with one of the methods shown (bank / wallet transfer with the transaction ID, or crypto). The plan starts when the payment is confirmed.
**Devices:** your account lists the devices you use; a plan allows a set number of them at the same time.
**Security:** change your password there; use **Forgot password?** on the login page if you lose it.

b: Check your internet, then reload the page. If one symbol has no data, the broker feed may be closed (weekend) or busy for a moment.

b: Your plan does not include it. Open the account button → **Upgrade or renew**.
Drawings are saved with each chart a few seconds after you draw. Check that you are logged in to the same account and that the drawing is not hidden for this interval (**Visibility**).
Only through the MT5 bridge (ICT Bridge EA) on your own MetaTrader 5 account, for approved models and plans that include it. Start on a demo account.

Trading CFDs, forex, indices and crypto with leverage carries a high risk of losing money quickly. ICT Terminal is an analysis and learning tool, not financial advice. The models follow fixed rules and many setups lose; past results do not promise future results. Only trade with money you can afford to lose.
